adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil, it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` for every request (`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb`, new file). The only access gate shown is `ensure_embeddable`, which trusts `request.referer` host equality (`URI(request.referer||'').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) and sets `X-Frame-Options = ALLOWALL`; `Referer` is a client-supplied header and can be trivially spoofed by non-browser clients. The 60s throttle is implemented inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` (in `lib/topic_retriever.rb`) and is only applied when the job runs, not before enqueue, so an attacker can flood Sidekiq with `retrieve_topic` jobs plus repeated DB lookups by issuing many GETs with a spoofed referer and varying `embed_url` values.
